name: PromptSpend

apple.subtitle: Know your AI cost before it
apple.promotionalText: Paste a representative conversation, compare up to four LLMs, and turn current API prices into a clear monthly cost—with private on-device prompt handling.
apple.description:
Know the tab before you build.

PromptSpend turns a representative AI conversation into an understandable cost forecast before the first production invoice arrives. Paste sample text or enter known token counts, choose your traffic, and see the cost per conversation, day, month, and year.

COMPARE THE SAME WORKLOAD
Select up to four LLMs and compare their estimated costs side by side. PromptSpend calculates pasted text separately for each model family, ranks the results, and shows the monthly difference from the lowest-cost option.

SEE THE FULL COST STORY
Explore input, output, prompt-cache writes, long-context tiers, reasoning assumptions, batch discounts, and conversation growth. The Cost Brief, sensitivity lab, and savings playbook help explain what changes the number and which levers may reduce it.

CURRENT PRICES WITH EVIDENCE
PromptSpend downloads a validated public catalog, shows when sources were checked, flags disagreements for review, and refuses to hide an expired offline cache behind a reassuring number. Open the evidence and public sync status whenever you want to inspect the work.

SHARE A DECISION, NOT A SCREENSHOT
Create a readable estimate, four-model comparison, CSV export, restorable website scenario, or AI Cost Receipt. Shared results contain derived counts, assumptions, costs, and source dates—not your pasted prompt text.

LEARN AS YOU GO
Short guides explain tokenization, context growth, caching, pricing provenance, and the limits of any estimate. Global Search and a guided tour make deep features easy to find.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose system, light, or dark appearance; four accessible accent colors; and cool or warm canvas styles. The Market Pulse ticker can be paused and respects Reduce Motion.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Pasted text is processed on your device and is not uploaded or saved by PromptSpend. There is no native account, advertising SDK, behavioral analytics, cross-app tracking, or tracking identifier. Saved scenarios and appearance settings stay on your device.

PromptSpend estimates published API charges from the workload and assumptions you provide. Actual bills, model quality, latency, availability, regional pricing, negotiated rates, and provider behavior can vary. Validate a representative workload before making a production decision.
